tools.name: generate_birth_poster
tools.description: Use this when the user wants a birth stats poster, a baby birth announcement printable, a nursery birth print or a birth stats sign. Put each detail in its own field (name, birth_date, birth_time, place, parents). Returns a print-ready PDF at 8x10 (default), 11x14, A4, A3 or a 5x7 card with the date

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "generate_birth_poster" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
